dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, it's my first exam at a Thai university. Are we allowed to use phones in the exam room?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, ɪts maɪ ˈfɜːrst ɪɡˈzæm ət ə ˈtaɪ ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti. ər wiː əˈlaʊd tə ˈjuːz ˈfoʊnz ɪn ði ɪɡˈzæm ˈruːm?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: No, you aren't allowed to bring phones into the room. You have to leave them outside.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, juː ˈɑːrnt əˈlaʊd tə ˈbrɪŋ ˈfoʊnz ɪntə ðə ˈruːm. juː ˈhæf tə ˈliːv ðɛm ˌaʊtˈsaɪd.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: We're allowed to use a dictionary in some exams, but not in English exams.
dialogue.reading: wɪr əˈlaʊd tə ˈjuːz ə ˈdɪkʃənɛri ɪn sʌm ɪɡˈzæmz, bʌt ˈnɑːt ɪn ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ɪɡˈzæmz.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: And what happens if someone cheats?
dialogue.reading: ənd ˈwʌt ˈhæpənz ɪf ˈsʌmwʌn ˈtʃiːts?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: The punishment is serious. Students who cheat get a zero, and they might have to leave the university.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈpʌnɪʃmənt ɪz ˈsɪriəs. ˈstuːdənts huː ˈtʃiːt ˈɡɛt ə ˈzɪroʊ, ənd ðeɪ maɪt ˈhæf tə ˈliːv ðə ˌjuːnɪˈvɜːrsəti.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Oh, that's strict. Is discipline strict in class, too?
dialogue.reading: ˈoʊ, ðæts ˈstrɪkt. ɪz ˈdɪsəplɪn ˈstrɪkt ɪn ˈklæs, ˈtuː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not really, but you need eighty percent attendance to take the exam.
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈriːli, bʌt juː ˈniːd ˈeɪti pərˈsɛnt əˈtɛndəns tə ˈteɪk ði ɪɡˈzæm.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So I'm not allowed to skip class?
dialogue.reading: soʊ aɪm ˈnɑːt əˈlaʊd tə ˈskɪp ˈklæs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're allowed to miss a few classes, but don't skip class too often.
dialogue.reading: jʊr əˈlaʊd tə ˈmɪs ə ˈfjuː ˈklæsɪz, bʌt ˈdoʊnt ˈskɪp ˈklæs ˈtuː ˈɔːfən.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: OK. And are we allowed to wear jeans to class?
dialogue.reading: oʊˈkeɪ. ənd ər wiː əˈlaʊd tə ˈwɛr ˈdʒiːnz tə ˈklæs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Thai students have to wear a uniform, but exchange students are allowed to wear what they like.
dialogue.reading: ˈtaɪ ˈstuːdənts ˈhæf tə ˈwɛr ə ˈjuːnəfɔːrm, bʌt ɪksˈtʃeɪndʒ ˌstuːdənts ər əˈlaʊd tə ˈwɛr ˈwʌt ðeɪ ˈlaɪk.
